about: Taskbar button menus in Windows 11 wording ("Pin to taskbar", "Unpin from taskbar") without KDE's widget settings and edit mode entries; window tooltips with Windows' plain close glyph. The icons-only taskbar (org.kde.plasma.icontasks) uses this package's QML. Matched against plasma-desktop 6.3.6 (Debian 13).

replacements.new: text: Qt.locale().name.startsWith("tr") ? "Görev çubuğuna sabitle" : "Pin to taskbar" // VeltOS: Windows' wording
text: Qt.locale().name.startsWith("tr") ? "Görev çubuğundan sabitlemeyi kaldır" : "Unpin from taskbar" // VeltOS: Windows' wording

replacements.why: no entry opening KDE's widget settings dialog
replacements.old:
enabled: configureAction && configureAction.enabled
        visible: configureAction && configureAction.visible
replacements.new:
enabled: configureAction && configureAction.enabled
        visible: false // VeltOS: VeltOS Settings has the taskbar options
visible: false // VeltOS: the taskbar is not edited like a KDE panel

                icon.name: "window-close-symbolic" // VeltOS: Windows' plain close glyph
